# AOL

> > AOL's news and content platform featuring financial analysis from The Motley Fool, investment insights on energy infrastructure, and business coverage across technology, retail, and entertainment sectors.

This content archive showcases AOL's role as a digital media publisher, aggregating expert financial commentary and business news. The site features extensive coverage of energy markets (Permian Basin, Eagle Ford shale), stock analysis, and investment strategies, with contributions from financial analysts and business wire services.

## Key Topics

- The Motley Fool financial analysis
- Stock analysis and investment strategies
- Energy infrastructure and pipelines
- Permian Basin and Eagle Ford shale
- Natural gas and crude oil markets
- Master Limited Partnerships (MLPs)
- Quarterly earnings reports
- Dividend stocks and ETF investing
- Retail sector performance
- Revenue growth analysis
- Canadian energy markets
- Midstream energy operations
- Business Wire announcements
- S&P Capital IQ data

## Energy & Oil Investment Analysis

- [Investing in Tommorow's America: Energy](https://www.aol.com/2013/10/12/investing-in-the-infrastrucutre-of-tommorows-ameri): Motley Fool analysis of US energy infrastructure and Permian Basin pipelines
- [Is This Oil Company Pioneering a Carbon Sequestration Movement?](https://www.aol.com/2013/05/20/is-this-oil-company-pioneering-a-carbon-sequestrat): Denbury Resources carbon sequestration and CO2-enhanced oil recovery analysis
- [3 Risks to Watch at Devon Energy](https://www.aol.com/2013/02/22/3-reasons-to-worry-about-devon-energy): Devon Energy investment risk analysis covering gas pricing and Canadian crude
- [Is Marathon Oil Poised to Pop?](https://www.aol.com/2012/11/19/is-marathon-oil-poised-to-pop): Marathon Oil stock analysis featuring Eagle Ford shale assets evaluation
- [KKR to Acquire Ontario Solar Projects](https://www.aol.com/2013/02/15/kkr-to-acquire-ontario-solar-projects): KKR acquisition of SSM Solar photovoltaic projects from Starwood Energy
